bio.text: Mark Anderson represents Connecticut's 62nd House District, which includes Barkhamsted, Granby, Hartland and New Hartford, and was elected to his third term in November 2024.
He was born in Hartford, was raised in East Granby and in Granville, Massachusetts, and has lived in Granby since 2015.
He graduated from Western New England University and completed a master's in public policy at Liberty University.
He had a long career as an Army Reserve officer in the Military Intelligence branch and retired as a lieutenant colonel.
